screens.title: Lesson 2: Needs vs wants
screens.text: Some things we must have. Some things are just fun. Let us learn the difference. Press Start when you are ready.

art.alt: Bread, water and a coat, compared with a toy, a game and candy

screens.text: A need is something we must have to stay safe and healthy. Food, water, a warm coat and a bed are needs.

art.alt: Food, water, a coat and a bed

screens.text: A want is something that is fun or nice to have. We can live without it. A toy, a game and candy are wants.

art.alt: A toy, a game and candy

screens.prompt: Is water a need or a want?

options.label: A need
options.why: A need. Our bodies must have water every day to stay healthy.

options.label: A want
options.why: Water is something we must have, so it is a need. Some drinks are just treats, but plain water keeps us healthy.

screens.text: Some wants are okay! Toys, games and treats make life fun. Wanting things is normal. We just think about it before we spend.

art.alt: A happy face with a toy and ice cream

screens.prompt: Is a video game a need or a want?

options.label: A need
options.why: Games are fun, but we can be safe and healthy without one. So a game is a want.

options.label: A want
options.why: A want. Games are fun, but we can be safe and healthy without one. Wants are okay!

screens.text: Sometimes one thing can be both. A coat is a need when you are cold. If your coat still fits and keeps you warm, a second fancy coat is a want.

art.alt: A warm coat, and then an extra fancy coat

screens.prompt: Your coat still fits and keeps you warm. A new fancy coat is on sale. Is the new coat a need or a want?

options.label: A need
options.why: Warm clothes are a need, and you already have a coat that works. The new one would be extra, so it is a want.

options.label: A want
options.why: A want. Your coat already keeps you warm. The new one would be nice, but you do not have to have it.

screens.text: When money is short, needs come first. We pay for food, water, clothes and a place to sleep. Then, if there is money left, we can think about wants. A want can wait, and we can save up for it.

talk.q: Pick one need and one want from this week. How are they different?
If we only had money for one thing today, how would we decide?
talk.note: Needs first, then wants. A want can wait and be saved for.

talk.q: Is there a want you are saving up for? How could we plan for it?

julianna.title: Julianna's turn: needs, wants and choices
julianna.intro: First, sort eight things into needs and wants. Then, you will make two choices when you can only buy one thing.

items.why: A need. We must eat to stay healthy.

items.prompt: A video game. Need or want?
items.why: A want. Fun, but we can be healthy without it.

items.prompt: A coat on a snowy day, when you have no coat. Need or want?
items.why: A need. We have to stay warm.
A want. A treat is nice, but we do not have to have it.
A need. Our bodies need water every day.

items.prompt: A new toy. Need or want?
items.why: A want. Toys are fun, and wants are okay.

items.prompt: A bed to sleep in. Need or want?
items.why: A need. We need good sleep.
A want. It is fun, but not something we must have.

items.prompt: You have $10. Your school shoes are too small and they hurt your feet. You also want a new game. You can only buy one right now. Which comes first, and why?

options.label: The game first, because it is more fun. My feet can wait.
The shoes first, because shoes that fit are a need. I can save up for the game.
Neither. I will spend it all on candy.

items.hint: Think about which one your body needs.
items.why: Right. Shoes that fit are a need, so they come first. The game is a want, and it can wait until you save up.

items.prompt: There is money for one thing today: food for lunch this week, or a new toy. Which comes first, and why?

options.label: Food first. We need to eat, and the toy can wait.
The toy first. I have wanted it a long time.
The toy first. I can ask for food later.

items.hint: Which one can wait, and which one cannot?
items.why: Right. Food is a need, so it comes first. The toy is a want. Waiting for it can even make it feel better when we finally get it.

dorian.title: Dorian's turn: need or want
dorian.intro: Hi Dorian! Tap the heart for a need. A need is something we must have. Tap the star for a want. A want is something fun. Press the big green button to start.

art.alt: A heart for a need and a star for a want

items.prompt: Bread. Heart for a need, star for a want.
items.say: Bread. Tap the heart for a need, or the star for a want.
items.why: Bread is a need. We need food to grow.

items.prompt: A video game. Heart for a need, star for a want.
items.say: A video game. Tap the heart for a need, or the star for a want.
items.why: A game is a want. It is fun!

items.prompt: Water. Heart for a need, star for a want.
items.say: Water. Tap the heart for a need, or the star for a want.
items.why: Water is a need. Our bodies need water.

items.prompt: A teddy bear. Heart for a need, star for a want.
items.say: A teddy bear. Tap the heart for a need, or the star for a want.
items.why: A teddy is a want. Teddies are nice to hug!

items.prompt: A bed. Heart for a need, star for a want.
items.say: A bed. Tap the heart for a need, or the star for a want.
items.why: A bed is a need. We need sleep.

items.prompt: Candy. Heart for a need, star for a want.
items.say: Candy. Tap the heart for a need, or the star for a want.
items.why: Candy is a want. Yummy, but we do not need it.

items.prompt: It is cold outside. Tap what we need.

art.alt: A cold face with a snowflake

items.hint: Think about what keeps us warm.
items.why: A coat! We need a coat to stay warm.
